title: RIP Worker Protocol v1
description: JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio, newline-delimited. One JSON object per line, UTF-8. Defines handshake, execution with budget/idempotency, cancellation, and error codes. Referenced by workers/python/runtime/worker_runtime.py and the three M3 workers.

requestId.description: JSON-RPC id. REQUIRED on every request (protocol deviation from JSON-RPC notifications: this protocol has no notifications). Echoed verbatim in the response.

protocolVersion.description: Major protocol version string. v1 is exactly "1". A mismatch yields error -32000.

budget.description: Per-request execution budget. Applies to execute only. Defaults: timeout_ms=30000, max_output_bytes=1048576. Hard caps: timeout_ms in [1, 600000], max_output_bytes in [256, 67108864]. Violations yield error -32003.

max_output_bytes.description: Upper bound on the serialized single-line JSON-RPC response in UTF-8 bytes. Oversized results are replaced by a truncation envelope and usage.truncated=true.

usage.description: Execution accounting attached to every execute response.

tokens_est.description: Heuristic token estimate over the serialized result data: ceil(chars/4), minimum 1. Not a real tokenizer.

output_bytes.description: UTF-8 byte length of the response line actually delivered.

protocolError.description: Top-level JSON-RPC error object for transport/dispatch failures and execute preconditions.

code.description: -32700 parse error; -32600 invalid request; -32601 method not found; -32602 invalid params; -32603 internal error; -32000 protocol version mismatch; -32001 not initialized; -32002 budget timeout; -32003 budget invalid; -32004 cancelled; -32005 idempotency conflict; -32006 execution error; -32007 unknown cancel target; -32008 input error; -32009 unsupported format.

taskError.description: Error object inside an execute result when status is error or timeout.

truncationEnvelope.description: Replaces result.data when the response line would exceed budget.max_output_bytes.

data_head.description: Head of the original serialized data JSON, cut at a UTF-8 character boundary. String, so always valid JSON inside the envelope.

task.description: Worker-specific input. Shape defined per worker; parsing: {text|path, format?}; embedding: {text|texts, dim?, ngram_range?, model?} where model in {hashing-ngram-v1 (default, 256-dim hash), bge-small-zh-v1.5 (512-dim onnx, hash-fallback when unavailable)}, optional dim must equal the resolved backend output dim (no silent truncation; -32602 otherwise), data carries a backend field (hash | onnx:bge-small-zh-v1.5 | hash-fallback); evaluation: {entries, rules?|rules_path?}. Debug op sleep/boom requires env WORKER_ALLOW_DEBUG=1.

idempotency_key.description: Non-empty string. Same key + same task (and same worker_version) returns the cached result with cached=true. Same key + different task returns error -32005. Cache file: <workers>/.cache/<sha256(key)>.json.

executeResult.description: The result member of an execute response. status=result|error|timeout. Cached hits reuse a stored result with cached=true. Cancelled tasks return status=error with code -32004.

cached.description: true when the response was served from the idempotency cache.

data.description: Worker output when status=result. Either the worker payload or a truncationEnvelope.

cancelled.description: true when the target was still running and the cancellation token was set.
